Does NOT execute trades and does NOT delete a recorded holding or its transactions; a holding with recorded transactions cannot be removed through this tool. Does NOT accept more than one ticker per call.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: discover_stocks, get_market_summary · Private data: add_to_watchlist · Public sink: fetch_analysis_result · Destructive: add_to_watchlist, initiate_analysis, remove_from_watchlist.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: discover_stocks, get_market_summary · Private data: add_to_watchlist · Public sink: fetch_analysis_result · Destructive: add_to_watchlist, initiate_analysis, remove_from_watchlist

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "discover_stocks" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
